edges.label: The Debrief published the Grusch story the NYT did not run
edges.note: The same authors whose AATIP scoop the New York Times published in 2017 took the 2023 Grusch story to The Debrief. The placement, not the verification, is the notable fact.

edges.label: The New York Times did not publish the 2023 Grusch story
edges.note: The same two authors who wrote the paper's 2017 AATIP revelation took the 2023 crash-retrieval story elsewhere. Recorded as a denial-type edge because the decision not to publish is itself an act by an institution, and one that shaped what the public record looks like.

b.label: New York Times, 'Glowing Auras and Black Money: The Pentagon's Mysterious U.F.O. Program'

edges.label: Successor venue to the 2017 New York Times story
edges.note: The 2017 NYT article and the 2023 Debrief article share two of three authors and a continuous line of argument; the change of venue between them is a data point about institutional appetite, not about the reporting.
